Yes, you can absolutely install OpenClaw on a Digital Ocean Droplet (and it’s actually a very common and well-supported way to run it 24/7). OpenClaw is an open-source autonomous AI agent that you self-host. It turns LLMs (such as Anthropic Claude) into a real action-taking assistant that lives in your chat apps — in this project, primarily **Telegram**.

You give it **text or voice commands** via Telegram, and it can:

- Build / create new specialized agents
- Direct those agents (or swarms of them)
- Run shell commands, browser automation (via Firecrawl and Playwright), statistical analysis in Python or R, PDF generation, email sending with attachments, file operations, and more
- Remember everything persistently and work autonomously with a heartbeat scheduler

**Project-Specific Workflow (Marketing Class Requirement):**  
All tasks must be initiated through **Telegram text or voice notes**. The main OpenClaw agent (or directed swarm) will:

1. Research the marketing question or analyze provided/uploaded datasets (using Firecrawl for web data or local file access).
2. Perform specified statistical analyses (e.g., descriptive stats, regression, segmentation, hypothesis testing, sentiment analysis).
